stage: POLARIS STAGE 8.14C — BLOCKER PLAN SCIENTIFIC HARDENING AUDIT

ctth_dependency_audit.upstream_inputs: RTOV inversion mapping 10.8um/13.4um thermal radiances against ECMWF/MEPS vertical T/RH forecast profiles
ctth_dependency_audit.stage8_8_reconciliation: Complete overlap with Stage 8.8 MEPS vertical cloud geometry (which was REJECTED)
ctth_dependency_audit.scientific_verdict: REJECTED AS OPTICAL FALLBACK. CTTH is strongly NWP-derived and re-introduces rejected Stage 8.8 cloud geometry. It CANNOT legitimately serve as a fallback for novel optical transmissivity (COT).

non_optical_variable_audit.scientific_verdict: VALID THERMAL FALLBACK. Observed binary cloud presence/absence grid that operates in darkness without NWP profile dependency.

missingness_semantics.zero_imputation_rule: PROHIBITED FOR COT/CER. Zero COT physically implies clear sky, which is false during cloudy polar night. Polar night MUST be represented via explicit binary indicators and dual-branch features.

coverage_gate_review.scientific_flaw: Polar night (SZA > 84°) covers 57/347 origins (16.4%). Daylight optical COT can NEVER exceed 83.6% (290/347 origins) across a full-year benchmark.

hardened_thresholds.daylight_origin_optical_gate: >=90% usable optical retrievals within the 290 Daylight Origins (SZA <= 84°)
hardened_thresholds.benchmark_completeness_gate: 100% of 347 origins must receive an auditable state classification via dual-branch architecture without dropping origins

required_corrections: Remove ctth_temp/ctth_press as a fallback for novel optical information; replace with observed thermal cloud mask (cma).
Prohibit zero-imputation of COT/CER during polar night (SZA > 84°); use explicit polar_night indicator flags and dual-branch features.
Replace unachievable >=90% overall optical coverage gate with Daylight Origin Optical Coverage Gate (>=90% of daylight origins) and 347-Origin Dual-Branch Benchmark Gate.
